Manufacturing Engineer

Accomplished Engineering Professional with a proven track record in design, project leadership, and driving financial/cost reduction strategies. Renowned for enhancing productivity and implementing cost containment systems. Expertise in process optimisation and leading continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies. Experienced Mechanical Engineer with over 10 years of expertise in the aerospace sector. Wellregarded for problem-solving acumen and consistently improving customer satisfaction through innovative solutions and effective collaboration
